text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright achieved a magnificent 
victory over Matikanefukukitaru in the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her running proved she had what it takes 
for long distances. Based on this result, 
which path should she take— Long-distance, 
or medium-distance...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, in the Stayers Stakes, they decided 
to test Mejiro Bright's talent as a 
stayer.
